items.title: Send feedback
items.text: Report a bug or suggest something from the title bar: you write the report in the app and send it from GitHub.

items.title: Scales and chords
items.text: Choose the song's scale in the piano roll or on the virtual keyboard: notes land in the scale and you write chords with one click, with their inversions.

items.title: VST2 and 32-bit plugins
items.text: Besides 64-bit VST3, VST2 and 32-bit plugins now open too. The menus mark which ones they are.

items.title: Automate from the plugin
items.text: Click **Automate** in its window's bar and move a parameter: its lane is created.

items.title: Edit several tracks at once
items.text: With several tracks picked, the inspector changes what they share and right-click acts on all of them.

items.title: Stretch a clip
items.text: **Ctrl** + dragging the trim handle stretches it without changing the pitch. Attacks stay in place, so it works on rhythm loops.

items.title: Changing the tempo asks what to do
items.text: Choose **Stretch** the clips or **Grid only**.

items.title: Pitch per clip
items.text: Right-click a clip → **Pitch**: −12 to +12 semitones, added to the track's.

items.title: 96 compressor presets
items.text: By instrument and by use, in 12 categories. **Analyze take** fits them to the recorded level.

items.title: Snap and shortcuts for faster editing
items.text: The snap has **Line**, **Cell** and more divisions. **Shift** + drag copies a clip, {key:alignGrid} aligns it to the grid, {key:selectAll} marks everything and {key:deselect} clears the selection.

items.title: New track, no fixed bar
items.text: The **+** sits at the foot of the track headers, and right-clicking the empty timeline area opens the same menu.

items.title: The loop turns without cuts
items.text: It wraps on the exact sample: the start comes in whole and the click keeps its beat.

items.title: New faders and knobs
items.text: Faders, knobs and mixer with more contrast, the selected track with a colored border, and a refreshed icon.

items.title: Refreshed help and this window
items.text: Topics with icons, the most searched at hand, and each version's changes always one click away on {icon:E789}.

items.title: Automation
items.text: Volume, pan, sends and effect and instrument parameters, on lanes below each track.

items.title: Split into stems
items.text: Vocals, drums, bass and more, each on its own track. It uses the video card if there is a compatible one.

items.title: Patterns
items.text: Linked MIDI clips: editing one changes them all. With their own tab to drag them onto tracks.

items.title: Everything follows the tempo
items.text: Changing the BPM changes the song's speed, keeping the pitch: clips, automation, markers and loop stay on their bar.

items.title: Detect scale and chords
items.text: Right-click an audio clip. Chords can stay on a strip of the timeline.

items.title: More effects
items.text: Chorus, Flanger, Phaser and Tremolo, a 7-band dynamic EQ, and the master's effects on any channel.

items.title: Modular mastering
items.text: The master chain is a list of modules you drag to change the order.

items.title: Reverse a clip
items.text: It plays backwards without touching the file.

items.title: Sample library
items.text: Your sound folders, with search, favorites and preview. Importing is much faster and takes almost any format.

items.title: Help inside the app
items.text: Topics by category, with search. Open it with {key:help}.

items.title: Optional components
items.text: FFmpeg and the stem models install from the app, in **Settings → Components**.

items.title: Now called XTreme
items.text: New name and icon. Your projects and settings stay where they were.
